name: io.github.kakha13/esim-mcp
description: Compare travel eSIM plans by country, and regional vs local pricing for multi-country trips.

environmentVariables.name: CHEAPERESIM_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional read-only CheapereSIM API token. Without it the five plan-search tools work normally. With it, two extra tools can list the eSIMs on your account and their remaining data. Create one at https://cheaperesim.com/dashboard/api-tokens

environmentVariables.name: CHEAPERESIM_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://cheaperesim.com and only needs changing for local development.

environmentVariables.name: CHEAPERESIM_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
